description: Use this when a visitor asks which hotels at a supported resort have rooms on given nights, or their lowest rates. Up to 14 nights within the next 120 days, as last checked; Parky cannot book hotels. Ask for the fewest days you need; long ranges are large.

date.description: First night, YYYY-MM-DD, from today through 119 days ahead. Defaults to tonight.

days.description: Number of nights, 1 to 14. Defaults to 7.

resort.description: Resort key (walt-disney-world, disneyland-resort, universal-orlando, universal-studios-hollywood), canonical ID, name, or shorthand (wdw, dlr, uor, ush).

name: parky_get_hotel_availability
title: Get hotel availability
